name: crabbus
description: Star-topology observability for subagents: the master reads what each one is doing (observed, declared, verified), tracks SendMessage delivery, and animated pixel crabs show it live in the terminal.

fps.title: Animation frames per second
fps.description: 1 to 10 frames per second for the crabs (default 6)

reduceMotion.title: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: Draw one still frame per state instead of animating

openOnStart.title: Open the pane on session start
openOnStart.description: Show the CrabBus pane (master crab and subagents) as soon as Claude Code starts

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: auto: one discreet line only while the side pane is not shown; stage: the full animated stage there too; off: never
